# Assets: Get an Asset

Area overview and notes: [assets.md](../assets.md)

`GET /assets/{id}` · tenant-scoped token

Retrieves a single configured asset by id. Returns a `404` when no configured asset matches the supplied id.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | The unique identifier (UUID) for the Asset. |

**Response 200**: Asset retrieved successfully.

Same fields as the response of [Look Up an Asset](look-up-an-asset.md).

**Errors:** 401 Unauthorized · 403 Forbidden · 404 No asset is configured for the supplied id. · 429 Too Many Requests
